title: ArtQuire
tagline: ArtQuire is Built to Revolutionize how designers and artists showcase their talent, while users discover, customize, and collect unique digital art. Viewers can acquire art files, personalize them, and connect with designers for gigs.
description:
Our goal is to make a big change in how designers, artists, and creators show their talent. We want to give users like you the power to find, change, and collect amazing digital art.
The cool thing about ArtQuire is that you can get art files and make them even better by changing them. You can also show your appreciation to the artists and even talk to them about doing some work for you.
The techstack we used is 
Solidity - to make smart contract
hardhat - to deploy the smart contract
FVM - where we deployed the smart contract
Polybase - To make the database of the users and designers in our website
IPFS - to store the images and files designers want to sell
NFT.storage - to connect to ipfs to store data on it

The project has mainly 8 sections :
Recommended
Trending
Community Post
Profile
Analytics 
My NFTs
Post designs
Streaming

Each section implies what they mean in their Name

On our website, you'll find lots of different designs to explore. We have everything from illustrations to cool UI designs, so there's something for everyone.

You can find files for video edits, beautiful photoshopped images, or even music beats and music production files

In the coming months, we'll be launching the beta version of our platform. We have some exciting features in mind that we'll be adding. We're also open to any investment or support from judges, mentors, or sponsors who are interested in our project.
how_its_made:
The tech stack we employed includes Solidity for creating smart contracts, hardhat for smart contract deployment, FVM as the deployment environment, Polybase for managing user and designer databases on our website, IPFS for storing images and files that designers want to sell, and NFT.storage to connect with IPFS for data storage.

Our platform is divided into eight main sections, each serving a specific purpose. These sections are Recommended, Trending, Community Post, Profile, Analytics, My NFTs, Post Designs, and Streaming. The names themselves provide an indication of their functionalities.


Sponsers tech stack we used were

Polybase : It was easy integrating it and making schema and create , and read data from it onto our react frontend
IPFS : it  provided several benefits to our project. Firstly, it allowed us to store files in a peer-to-peer network , download uploaded files easily
NFT.storage : It was really easy using it just need an API and CID to upload and get the uploaded files on IPSF
FVM : Smart contract got deployed easily and can transfer filecoin to the account
